at_risk_backlog.description: Google CSP hosting agreement, minimum spend April 2026 to July 2033 regardless of usage, with a true-up.
Amazon agreement, minimum spend May 2026 to April 2036 regardless of usage.

Microsoft agreement of November 2025 as amended to November 2026: at least $47.2 billion and up to $49.2 billion, November 2026 to June 2033 (minimum shown). Grew from the $30 billion Azure commitment announced in November 2025 (ev_120065).

SpaceXAI arrangements for NVIDIA GPU compute, up to this amount into 2029, about $3.1 billion a month at full delivery; cancellable on 90 days notice after initial periods ending January and March 2027 (ev_120048).
Nscale GPU services agreements for NVIDIA GPU compute into 2033; fees accrue only on delivery; Nscale must obtain financing (ev_40030).
Lambda agreements for NVIDIA GPU compute into 2034; the August 2026 agreement (about $34.9 billion of the total) is currently terminable because Lambda did not secure the facility lease.
Five-year Broadcom master equipment leases (finance leases), rent excluding interest.
